title: Simply the best!
body: Seriously this is just the best collection of apps.  Effective, adorable, detailed yet simple,  and easy to use!  Customization options are perfect, and with the widget feature it’s genuinely life changing!  The lovely app creator is always available via email to assist with any issues or answer questions you might have.  Truly wonderful.  I can’t wait to see this app listed as one of the years best in magazines like Forbes and Cosmo — just a matter of time!
author: @jessicaleighallen

title: Pretty
body: Really pretty and great user interface, but only 3 free habits. Not worth it for me.
author: Lbechkos17

title: Very cute and detailed!
body: You can set multiple alarms for your habit, you can set time, e.g., if your goal is 120 min, you can tick 20 min of it, then it has beautifal and cute platform, a lot if icons, full of colors and very user-friendly really!

title: Amazing & Adorable
body: Works amazing, cute icons already in the app, super smooth too

title: So cute!!
body: I love this app! It’s easy to use and super cute! It makes staying on track/building new habits a little more fun ☺️
author: archie'smom92

title: STUNNING!
body: I am so thrilled with this tracker, as well as the two other beautiful agenda & budget apps from this developer. This habit tracker is well worth the small lifetime fee and I was so happy to show my support! The app is beautiful to look at and has everything you need to create and maintain healthy habits. I look forward to using the app, just because it’s so pretty! Thank you so much for creating these beautiful and helpful tools, I look forward to see what is to come :)

title: Love it!
body: So cute and helps me improve on my habits!

title: Looks cute but I didn’t mean to purchase anything
body: I got a pop up for their purchase option and accidentally purchased their sale thing,and I thought deleting the app could get my money back but it ended up just going back to its original thing still asking me to purchase the thing I already accidentally purchased. Did I end up getting my money back or did I lose it forever. If there’s a way to get my money back please let me know😭. I’m to tight for money to be making unnecessary purchases right now:(.
author: M$y$ :3

title: Why even
body:
You can literally only get one habit. 
Complete waste of time, and would be a waste of money if you decided to buy their subscription. There are so many better apps out there where you can actually use them without having to pay money each year. I would recommend looking elsewhere, and not bothering to waste your time with this app. Truly disappointing
author: Users1111

title: paywall):
body: very nice concept I love the simplicity and icons. But if you don’t pay at least $10, most of your screen is taken up by a huge ad encouraging you to upgrade the app, and nearly every feature you click brings you back to this ad. I think it would be better to just make this a paid app since if you don’t pay, you’re only allowed to set 3 habits and you can’t even get notifications for them.
